videos.caption: If there is one meal that belongs on your fall dinner table, it’s a cozy pot roast. Slow cooked until tender, served over creamy mashed potatoes and finished with a rich broth. It’s the ultimate comfort meal for fall 🍂 Full recipe down below, you can also find it in the link in my bio 🤎  Beef pot roast Ingredients: 	⁃	2-3 lb chuck roast 	⁃	1 medium white onion, sliced 	⁃	3 celery stalks, diced 	⁃	3 large carrots, sliced  	⁃	Bite size potatoes 	⁃	5 garlic cloves, minced 	⁃	Rosemary  	⁃	Thyme 	⁃	2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 	⁃	3 tbsp tomato paste 	⁃	2 Au jus gravy packets 	⁃	6 cups beef bone broth 	⁃	3 tbsp unsalted butter 	⁃	2 tbsp onion powder 	⁃	2 tbsp garlic powder 	⁃	Salt to taste Instructions: Wash and prep all of your vegetables. Peel and dice the carrots, slice the onion, mince the garlic, and dice the celery. Season the chuck roast to your liking. I used onion powder, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Make sure to season all sides of the roast. Add oil to a Dutch oven and sear the roast on all sides for 3–4 minutes per side. Remove the roast from the pot and set aside. Add the celery and onion to the pot and cook over medium heat until the onion has caramelized. Add the minced garlic last to prevent it from burning. Add the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce, and gravy packets. Add ½ cup of beef broth to deglaze the pot, then pour in the remaining broth. Add the seasonings and taste to make sure everything is seasoned to your liking. Add the roast back to the pot, along with the carrots, potatoes, butter, and a bunch of rosemary and thyme tied together with butcher’s twine. Cover and place in a 350°F oven for 3 hours. About 30 minutes before the roast is finished, prepare the mashed potatoes. To assemble, add a bed of mashed potatoes to a plate, then top with the roast, potatoes, and carrots. Finish with some of the broth and fresh or dried parsley. Enjoy! 🤎 #fall #fallrecipes #potroast #cozyvibes #fallvibes

Apple strudel is a traditional Viennese strudel, a popular pastry in Austria, Switzerland, Bavaria, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Italy, and other countries in Europe. Ingredients Strudel dough: • 1/3 cup lukewarm water (80 ml / 80 g) • 1 tablespoon + ½ teaspoon neutral tasting vegetable oil (15 g) • ½ teaspoon vinegar (or lemon juice) • 1/8 teaspoon fine salt • 145 g bread flour (about 1 cup) (it works with all purpose flour too) • ½ teaspoon vegetable oil for brushing the dough • flour for dusting Apple filling: • 3 tablespoons unsalted butter (40 g) • 2/3 cups fine, dry bread crumbs (80 g) • 5 tablespoons granulated sugar (65 g) • ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon • 4 tablespoons raisins (50 g) • 3 tablespoons rum for soaking the raisins  • 2 lbs sweet-tart apples (900 g to 1 kg) (e.g. MacIntosh)  • 1 tablespoon lemon juice • 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing the dough (divided) • confectioner’s sugar for dusting • whipped cream for serving

SLOPPY JOE BUNS RECIPE BELOW Ingredients DOUGH 250 ml lukewarm milk (1 cup) 15 g honey (1 tbsp) 7 g instant yeast (1 tbsp) 1 large egg 45 g unsalted butter, room temperature (3 tbsp, 1/2 stick) 500 g all-purpose flour (4 cups) 8 g fine salt (1⅓ tsp) SLOPPY JOE FILLING 25 ml olive oil (2 tbsp) 600 g ground beef (1⅓ lb) 4 g fine salt (⅔ tsp) 3 g paprika (1 tsp) 2 g garlic powder (⅔ tsp) 3 g onion powder (1 tsp) 3 g cayenne pepper (1 tsp) 1.5 g black pepper (½ tsp) 100 g ketchup (6 tbsps) EXTRA cheese slices (American or cheddar) Big Mac-style burger sauce 1 egg, beaten Sesame seeds Instructions Prepare all the ingredients. In a large bowl, combine the lukewarm milk, honey and yeast. Stir well and let the mixture rest for 5 minutes. Add the egg and butter and mix well. Add the flour and salt. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl and let the dough rise in a warm spot for 1 hour, or until doubled in size. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef, salt, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper and black pepper. Cook for 7-8 minutes, until browned and cooked through. Add the ketchup. Stir the ketchup into the beef until well combined. Let the filling cool completely before adding it to the dough. Deflate the risen dough and divide it into 9 equal pieces. Shape each piece into a ball. Roll each dough ball into a round sheet. Place a slice of cheese in the center of each disc, then top with some of the beef filling and a spoonful of burger sauce. Add extra cheese if you like. Fold the dough inwards and pinch it tightly closed. Place the buns seam side down on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with sesame seeds. Let rise for 30 minutes. Bake in a preheated oven at 200°C (400°F) for 12-18 minutes, or until golden brown. #food #sloppyjoe #beef #cheese #tiktokfood

Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Crispy cheeseburger wraps Ingredients  For the beef mixture: 1 lb ground beef ( 80% lean, 20% fat ) 2 tbsp oil 1 yellow onion, finely diced  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced 1 tbsp tomato paste Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  2 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tsp onion powder  1 large jalapeño, chopped 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1/2 cup water For the cheese burger sauce: 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp yellow mustard 1/2 tsp Worcestershire sauce  1 1/2 tbsp finely minced dill pickles 1 tbsp pickle juice 1 tsp finely minced onion 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/4 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp sugar 1/4 tsp black pepper To assemble: 9 medium tortilla wraps 1 1/2 cup Mexican style four cheese  1/2 cup caramelized onions 1/3 cup picked jalapeños, chopped  Oil for pan frying  Method: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and cook 3–4 minutes until softened. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds. Add beef and cook, breaking it up, until browned and fully cooked. Drain excess fat if needed, leaving a little behind. Add tomato paste, salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika and onion powder. Cook 1–2 minutes. Add Worcestershire sauce jalapeños and water. Simmer uncovered 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the liquid has completely reduced and the beef is moist but not watery. Taste and adjust salt if needed. Remove from heat and cool slightly. For the sauce, mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce, pickles, pickle juice, onion, garlic powder, smoked paprika, sugar and black pepper until smooth. Refrigerate until ready to use. Lay out the tortillas and spread about 1 tbsp sauce slightly below the center. Add about 1/4 cup beef, 2 tbsp cheese, caramelized onions and pickled jalapeños. Fold the bottom over the filling, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place wraps seam-side down and cook 2–3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and crispy. Continue cooking until all sides are crisp and the cheese is melted. Rest 1–2 minutes, slice in half and serve immediately with extra cheeseburger sauce.  #recipe #cheeseburger

Remove the bacon from the pot, but leave the bacon grease. Chop the bacon. Add the diced bell peppers and diced onion to the pot. Cook until softened. Add the sausage and burger to the pot. Cook until browned, then drain the grease. Add all other ingredients to the pot (including the bacon, bell peppers, and onions). Simmer for two hours. Baked Smothered Chicken with Cilantro Lime Rice. This was a delicious and easy 100/10 dinner recipe that will be added to the rotation for sure!  Ingredients 8 chicken drumsticks 1 red bell pepper, sliced 1 yellow bell pepper, sliced 1 green bell pepper, sliced 1 white onion, sliced 2 cups chicken stock 1 1/2 tablespoons plain flour 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon all-purpose seasoning 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp dried parsley ½ tsp dried thyme ½ tsp chilli flakes, or to taste Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Oil, for coating the chicken and vegetables Method Preheat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Season the chicken and vegetables, Toss everything together thoroughly so the chicken and vegetables are well coated. Transfer everything to a large baking dish, arranging the drumsticks amongst the peppers and onions. In a separate bowl or jug, whisk the flour into the chicken stock until smooth and there are no lumps. Pour the flour-and-stock mixture around and over the chicken and vegetables. Cover and bake: Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 200°C for about 45 minutes  Remove the foil and continue baking for another 20–25 minutes, allowing the chicken to brown and the gravy to thicken. For extra colour and caramelisation, place the dish under the broiler/grill for a few minutes until the chicken is beautifully browned. Keep a close eye on it. Cilantro lime Rice  2 cups basmati rice, washed Water (as per rice cooking instructions) 1 tablespoon butter 1 teaspoon salt, or to taste 1 lime ¼ cup (15–20 g) fresh cilantro, finely chopped Rinse 2 cups of rice thoroughly under cold water until the water runs mostly clear. Transfer the rice to a saucepan and add the appropriate amount of water. Add the butter, salt and the juice of half a lime. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat and cook according to your usual rice-cooking method until the water has been absorbed and the rice is tender. Once cooked, turn off the heat and leave the rice covered in the saucepan for 10 minutes. This allows the remaining steam to finish cooking the grains and helps achieve a light, fluffy texture. Remove the lid and add the juice from the remaining half of the lime, followed by the freshly chopped cilantro. Gently fluff the rice with a fork, folding the cilantro and lime through the rice without breaking up the grains. Serve immediately alongside the smothered chicken. #dinnerideas #easyrecipes #quickmeals #homecooking #healthymeals
